_about: PARKED DRAFT (docs/narrative/pending/). A template library for the between-stage story beat, for any of the three co-op campaign pitches (homework 41: A Planet Run, B Episodes, C The Siege). Slots only: no new lore and no new names (Orb writes the universe). 30 templates in 9 families, the slot vocabulary, each fighter's voice hooks, and 45 filled samples (5 per family) for Orb to read; every sample line passes the narrative lint. Sample place names (Rankhold, Mendquay, Crownreach, Slagholt, Furrowlea) are placeholders pending Orb's marks. Claude-written.

slots.opp: The opponent fighter of the stage (a roster id; the display name comes from the names file).
slots.p2: The second player's fighter, or the CPU partner. Absent in a solo run.
slots.ally: Whichever of p2 or a CPU partner is on the player's side.
slots.third: A fighter who is neither opponent nor player (a roster id), or `silhouette` when unknown.
slots.home: The opponent's home place name (World's homes: Mendquay, Rankhold, Crownreach, Slagholt; names pending Orb).
slots.home_wear: The home place's wear state: untouched, damaged or fallen. A place state only.
slots.claim: The opponent's claim phrase (table below), from World's ring claim.
slots.last: The last result between these fighters: none, won, lost, won_close, lost_close, draw (time cap).
slots.wrecked: What the last meeting wrecked, from events the sim has: a tower, a crater, a fire, the pier (or `nothing`).
slots.mode: 1v1, 2v1 (co-op vs one), 3v1 (the Empress and her guards), or horde.
slots.next: The next stage's opponent and place, for a cliffhanger.
slots.toll_band: none, some or many: a coarse band of the run's toll. NEVER read by a Cyborg line (Legal ln04) and never worded as a score (c08).

PROTAGONIST.voice: Warm, quick, tactile. He grins, grades the blow, asks for the opponent's best. Concern for people is said to the opponent ("Fight me over here"). No apology during a fight; an apology and an offer to rebuild come after the fight.
PROTAGONIST.react: a grin and a question or a dare to start
PROTAGONIST.home: plain pride in the place, or a worry for it
PROTAGONIST.after: the apology and the promise to mend (flag a)
never: talking to objects or off-screen helpers

RIVAL.voice: Short, clipped, contractions. Live trash talk and the rank gag, now and then (third-rate, barely top ten, amateur, clown). Denies the opponent's skill; never admits respect openly; hates a head start.
RIVAL.open: a put-down in a few words
RIVAL.grudge: denies the last result, promises a different one
RIVAL.boast: recalls the result as a rank
RIVAL.needle: an insult aimed at the opponent

EMPRESS.voice: Royal "we", a booming laugh (Hahaha, Gahaha), sadistic and theatrical. Insults: rat, insect, clown. "Petitioner" at most once a beat and rarely. Never calls a guard in a 1v1; in a 3v1 she commands them.
EMPRESS.grudge: names the cost in a limb
EMPRESS.boast: claims she let the player win
EMPRESS.deny: refuses the clock or the result
EMPRESS.warn: a short message from the throne

CYBORG.voice: Ravenous bio-mech: protein, calories, chassis, limiter, sensors, snack, wreckage as fuel. Loud and lurching, never polite. No "sir", no waiter, chef or restaurant words.
CYBORG.grudge: thanks the player for wreckage; refuses the clock
CYBORG.wreck: reads the place's wear as fuel
CYBORG.ln04: Legal ln04: he reads a place's wear state (damaged, fallen) and a thing wrecked, never a casualty count (`toll_band` is not a slot for him), never a person, never a toll. No line, caption or card mentions people at a fallen place. No advantage grows with deaths. Nothing about him changes with the toll.
never: sir, madam, menu, table, chef, order, kitchen
a line that changes with casualties

lines.text: Took you long enough. Come up, amateur.
Nice view! Is the whole stair yours?
Our plains now, petitioner. Admire the horizon!
Flat and clear. I'll see you coming!
Come in! Plenty of scrap, plenty of room!
Big yard! Where do the cranes go?
Same crooked plank. Good to be home!
Cute pier. Shame about the company.
Warm-up crowd! Save some for me!
Keep up. I'm taking the left.
You broke our tower, rat. We'll break your arm.
Fair! Hit me as hard as you like!
Lucky swing. I've been counting the days.
Count harder! I've been training too!
Time called it. My stomach didn't!
Fine! Round two. Bring more plating!
You left good wreckage back there. Thanks!
Don't thank me. Fight me!
You, the loud one. I owe you a rematch.
Hahaha! Come and collect, clown!
Back again? I ranked you last time.
Rank me again. I'll climb!
We let you win, rat. Try that twice!
You let me? Then let me again!
A fluke. Flukes don't repeat.
Then show me the real one!
Your crater's still warm. Good steel in it!
Keep your eyes on me, not the dirt!
Time ended it. We refuse to be timed!
Ha! Then no clock this time!
Did you think the road was empty?
Oh, hello! Ready when you are!
Shortcut! It goes right through my yard.
This is not on the map!
Only one of you? How careless, rat.
Careless? I'm exactly where I meant to be.
Surprise! I've been waiting up here!
Predictable. I counted your footsteps.
Streets are clear. Something is coming this way.
Everyone inside! I'll meet it!
Hahaha! Carry on. We'll take the winner.
Stay out of this.
The more the merrier! Who's first?
That wreck is mine. I smelled it first!
Back off, scrap. I'm busy.
Someone's watching from the ridge. Not moving.
Let them look. Show them something!
Need a hand? Keep your guard up!
I didn't ask. Stay out of my way.
Nobody knows who it is yet.
Is that another fighter?
I rank myself first. Goodbye, amateur.
Fine! I'll beat you both!
Hahaha! We choose our side. Today, yours.
Welcome aboard! Try to keep up!
Wrecks on both sides. I'm torn!
Pick me! I promise a good fight!
I never switched. I outranked you.
Sure! Whatever you say!
Partners? We have a court.
Then bring your court along!
Smoke over Mendquay! The pier's burning!
Not my pier! Move, move!
Someone's climbing my stair. Hold the fight.
Go! Then I want my turn!
Home's all wreckage now. Lovely fuel!
Come on, then. Fight me for it!
Someone cracks our banners? Move, rat!
Go! I'll wait right here!
Sorry about the pier, everyone. I'll help rebuild.
Just don't break it twice!
We are watching, rat. Do hurry up!
Tick tock, snack. My stomach's counting!
Let it count. I'm ready!
That's all? Third-rate, start to finish.
Again! I just found your timing!
Your friend looks lost, rat. Poor thing!
Lost? I'm taking your crown.
Your pier's still crooked. So are you.
Crooked but standing! Come and see!
Next: Rankhold. Someone's waiting on the stair.
Someone's coming. We'll meet them next time.
While you fought, the harbour took damage.
Then let's go and help!
We will see you at the throne, rat.
Same time next stage? Don't be late!
I'm never late. You're early.

rules: Slots only; no new lore or names.
A beat is two or three lines (4 to 12 words each), skippable, and never decides an outcome.
A place state (untouched, damaged, fallen) and a thing wrecked are readable; a casualty count is not, and never for the Cyborg (ln04).
A home is colour and set piece, never numbers.
The Protagonist apologises only after a fight.
The Empress's guards speak only in a 3v1 (mode 3v1).
At most two beats a gap (one aftermath, one ahead), as in story-beats.md.
